hashSemantics.sourceCatalog: SHA-256 of the exact Git blob bytes emitted by `git show <commit>:<path>`; every cataloged source is an LF text blob, so the value is independent of checkout autocrlf settings.
hashSemantics.localTextFiles: SHA-256 of repository-ready UTF-8 bytes without BOM and with LF line endings.
hashSemantics.evidence: Local compact-oracle hashes use repository-ready LF bytes; source and generator hashes use the exact pinned Git blob bytes.
